findings.summary: P1-1: the README cited diagnostic measurements and sub-paths that are not in the archived diagnostic run; the evidence package contradicted itself.
P2-1: the FIX-OX-18 handoff was not durable, the committed test loses publication-enabled coverage, and the README did not explain why the fixture was switched instead of lengthening the barrier.
P3-1: AC-1 leant on the diagnostic proxy; B now asserts fixture.counts.assert(1, 0) at the barrier.
P3-2: redactions.json recorded post-sanitization bytes as originals for three files; originals are now reconstructed before the substitution.
P3-3: worktree-status.stdout predated the final evidence set; recaptured after the evidence set was final.
P3-4: the ~15 s latency may be environmental (catalog query cost grows with the number of schemas); FIX-OX-18 must check before calling it a production characteristic.
P3-5: the macOS __eh_frame linker warning is pre-existing and stays assigned to OX-284 final C.
